name: Syndicate
rootCause: Syndicate Labs’ Commons cross-chain bridge was compromised due to a private key leak. The attacker used the leaked upgrade key to maliciously upgrade the bridge contracts, draining approximately 18.5 million SYND tokens (worth ~$330,000) and ~$50,000 in user assets, for a total loss of $380,000. The incident was limited to specific chains, and the project pledged full compensation to affected users.

descriptions.text: Syndicate Labs’ Commons cross-chain bridge was compromised due to a private key leak. The attacker used the leaked upgrade key to maliciously upgrade the bridge contracts, draining approximately 18.5 million SYND tokens (worth ~$330,000) and ~$50,000 in user assets, for a total loss of $380,000. The incident was limited to specific chains, and the project pledged full compensation to affected users.

On 29 April 2026, the Syndicate Commons bridge on Base suffered a targeted protocol governance attack. The attacker seized upgrade admin rights, deployed malicious code to the bridge proxy, and drained 18.45 million SYND tokens (approx. $330,000,$380,000). Syndicate made all users whole using treasury reserves. Excessive privilege of the UpgradeExecutor contract allowed an authorized executor to seize ProxyAdmin ownership, enabling a malicious bridge upgrade and draining of all funds. The exploit was enabled by weak upgrade key controls (single signer, no hardware/MFA, inadequate operational security).
